glonet.label: GLONET (deterministic)
glonet.description: Single member GLONET forecast, 52 weekly starts.

glo12.label: GLO12 (deterministic)
glo12.description: Single member GLO12 forecast, 52 weekly starts.

gloens.label: GloEns
gloens.description: Mercator Ocean physics ensemble, 50 members, Thursday starts.

glowens.label: GLOW-ens
glowens.description: GLOW machine learning ensemble, 16 members, Wednesday starts.

observations_rmsd.title: Root mean square error against observations
observations_rmsd.note: Ensemble mean error for the ensembles, single member error for the two deterministic references, every one of them scored through the same class 4 matchup.

gridded_rmsd.title: Root mean square difference against GLORYS
gridded_rmsd.note: Quarter degree GLORYS reanalysis reference. Ensemble mean difference for the ensembles, single member difference for the two deterministic references. Systems built from or initialised by the GLORYS family are favoured by a GLORYS reference; weight the observation tables.

gridded_crps.title: Fair continuous ranked probability score against GLORYS
gridded_crps.note: Lower is better, in the unit of the variable.

gridded_spread_error_ratio.title: Spread error ratio against GLORYS
gridded_spread_error_ratio.note: Spread of the ensemble over its mean difference to GLORYS, without observation or analysis error, so it reads low; agreement with the analysis, not a calibration test.

observations_crps.title: Fair continuous ranked probability score against observations
observations_crps.note: Lower is better, in the unit of the variable.

observations_spread_error_ratio.title: Additive spread error ratio against observations
observations_spread_error_ratio.note: The observation error variance is added to the ensemble variance before the ratio.
